tuples.subject: penal_charge_form
tuples.quote: (vi) In respect of NPA accounts, penal charges shall be reversed to the extent it remains uncollected for the specific purpose of non-recognition of income.

tuples.subject: penal_charge_form
tuples.quote: However, the same shall be part of the total liability of the borrower to the bank, unless it is waived as per the bank's policy.
